label: Approvals fixed by natures, from approval as ground and invariance
meaning: Price of the divine-command rival: if approval coextends with goodness in every nature-fixed profile and base goodness is invariant there, the assessor's approvals are fixed by the natures, so the variation premise fails. A command theory that keeps invariance must deny nature-fixed approval variation, giving up a voluntarist command theory. It does not show which of approval and nature is explanatorily prior.
